manifestations.invariant: A transfer batch must either commit one double-entry netting draft or leave balances, per-batch net positions, settlement journal, and posting sequence byte-for-byte unchanged; mandate decisions for effective date, currency, debit account, and aggregate batch allowance must all complete before that draft begins, so any unauthorized instruction aborts the whole batch without a ledger change.
